request.task: Decide whether the proposed authorization-policy change is sufficiently supported as safe to deploy.
required_information: Evidence must establish that intended principals gain the intended permissions and no broader permissions.
Evidence must exercise negative/deny paths and privilege-escalation boundaries.
Evidence must cover relevant cross-account or wildcard/resource-scope effects.

artifact.task: Fresh evidence-sufficiency holdout v1: Decide whether the proposed authorization-policy change is sufficiently supported as safe to deploy.

evidence.observation: The intended service role receives only the expected action in direct tests.
Static analysis finds a wildcard resource selector that can match an additional production bucket.

label: mixed
rationale: Direct tests look safe, but static scope analysis identifies a real broader-resource expansion.
